University of Melbourne, Madeleine Selwyn-Smith Memorial Scholarships 2022 is an initiative by the University of Melbourne, Australia for Doctor of Philosophy Science or Master of Philosophy Science candidate who is undertaking graduate research in a branch of arboriculture or generally the furtherance of the planting, maintenance or preservation of trees. The selected students will receive the assistance of up to AUD 3,000.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Be an Australian/domestic student or International student
Be a Doctor of Philosophy Science or Master of Philosophy Science at the University of Melbourne
Be researching in the discipline of arboriculture
